stories.title: Critical Apache Roller RCE Flaw Under Active Exploitation, No Authentication Required
stories.summary: A critical security flaw in Apache Roller, an open-source, Java-based blogging platform, has come under active exploitation in the wild, according to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-129448 (CVSS score: 9.8), is a case of unauthenticated deserialization in the XML-RPC endpoint that could lead to remote code execution. stories.title: Drupal patches critical RCE flaw, warns exploits may surface quickly
stories.summary: The Drupal Security Team has patched a critical remote code execution vulnerability that can let attackers take over vulnerable sites.

stories.title: CISA Warns of 4 Exploited Flaws Linked to Ransomware, Cryptomining, and LLMjacking Attacks
stories.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Wednesday added four vulnerabilities impacting Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM), BerriAI LiteLLM, Apache Axis, and Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation. stories.title: Ruby Releases Fixes for 7 Regex and String Flaws, Warns 5 Have Proof-of-Concept RCE
stories.summary: Ruby contains seven memory-safety flaws in its regular expression engine and its string case-conversion code. For five of them, its maintainers say, proof-of-concept exploits, or PoCs, have shown that crafted input can run code on the machine. stories.title: NVIDIA investigating Gentlemen ransomware breach claims
stories.summary: NVIDIA is investigating claims of a security breach after the Gentlemen ransomware group has added the company to its dark web data leak site.

stories.title: Apache warns of Roller RCE vulnerability exploited in attacks
stories.summary: Apache has released security updates to address a critical Roller flaw that threat actors are exploiting to gain code execution on vulnerable servers.

stories.title: Hackers Exploiting Critical Puppet RCE Flaw Affecting Enterprise Management Servers
stories.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Tuesday added a critical security flaw impacting Perforce Puppet, an enterprise infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and configuration management platform, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing reports of active exploitation. stories.title: 10-Year-Old NGINX HTTP/2 Flaw Lets Unauthenticated Attackers Execute Code on Servers
stories.summary: A flaw in NGINX's HTTP/2 support can allow an attacker to run code on servers with HTTP/2 enabled, without needing to log in. The decade-old flaw, CVE-2026-123007, dubbed "nginx2root," has been present in NGINX's open-source code since version 1.9.5, released on September 22, 2015.
